results.title: Stablecoin Invoicing: Get Paid in USDC/USDT | Support
results.description: Stablecoin invoicing is the practice of billing a customer in a fiat-pegged digital asset such as USDC or USDT and accepting settlement onchain, typically through a payment link or wallet address attached to an invoice.
